release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.7.6 (Build 69): UI Layout Polish, Cloudflare Security Audit Hardening & Autonomous OTA Integrity Verification.
• Refined Legal & Compliance Layout: Fixed squished text on Terms of Service and Privacy Policy cards with clean vertical hierarchy and elegant spacing.
• Native PIN Brute-Force Defense: Progressive lockout (5 failed attempts = 5 min cooldown; 10 failed attempts = 30 min lockout + immediate parent push alert).
• Autonomous OTA Integrity Verification: Cryptographic SHA-256 verification and origin restriction before triggering APK install.
• Security Hardening: Closed unlinked profile exposure, hardened app restriction RLS, secured invite pairing RPC, and removed unverified optimistic Pro deep links.
• Secure System Config: Disabled ADB backups (android:allowBackup=false) and decommissioned legacy biometric permissions.
